messages.author: d763070a68ca6a43
messages.subject: Assigning snapshot UIDs
parts:
Hi Joe,

finally have some time for a test run of packrat and so far I really like it, great work!

One question though: is there any way to assign UIDs to the snapshots you're taking in order to being able to select a specific snapshot for a 'restore'?

IMHO, it would generally make sense to being able to distinguish between snapshot just as, for example, you can distinguish different commits/tags in Git?

Thanks,
Janko

messages.author: ab0d2be2ea8dabe8
messages.subject: Re: Assigning snapshot UIDs
parts:
Hi Janko,

We've elected to defer this functionality to the version control system the project is using -- we currently only record the last snapshot, and let e.g. git / svn manage the overall project history.

Cheers,
Kevin
